notes:
Six gestures that were missing.

Tabs now shrink to fit the strip instead of scrolling out of reach, and the
middle mouse button closes one — with the same unsaved-changes prompt the ×
already had.

In the file explorer, "New note" and "New folder" moved into the right-click
menu and the name field now appears inside the folder you picked, at its place
in the tree. Every file type gets its own icon, and any file or folder can be
tinted with one of seven colors that stay put when you switch themes — the
palette lives in Settings → Appearance, with a per-color reset.

Two more entries in that menu: **Copy path**, which puts the file's absolute
path on the clipboard, and **Reveal in Finder**, which selects a file in its
folder or opens a folder directly.
